reference.title: The robot
reference.inspected: Browser page screenshot; no source artwork downloaded.

generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: canonical production sprite for Atlas, a friendly robot guide in a 2D pixel-art high-fantasy Java-learning adventure.
Reference inspected by the art director: https://www.pinterest.com/pin/211174971843635/ titled "The robot". Its defining visual cues are a very large almost-square CRT monitor head, thick dark stepped outline, pale cream bezel, muted olive-tan casing with a side projection, deep teal-green screen, two small yellow square eyes and a chunky U-shaped yellow smile; a tiny square torso with a cream chest panel and short separated legs. Use those broad design cues as inspiration for a coherent original improved robot, not a literal copy.
Primary request: create exactly ONE full-body Atlas robot in a clean front-facing idle stance, with a tiny amount of visible case depth but strictly flat 2D sprite art. The oversized CRT head is about half the character height. Give its cream bezel crisply chamfered pixel corners, a dark teal screen, two bright warm-yellow square eyes and a small confident warm-yellow pixel smile. Muted olive/brass case and joints, a compact cream and olive torso with one simple teal diamond-shaped rune inset in the cream chest panel, short readable articulated arms and small mitten-like robotic hands held naturally by its sides, and two sturdy short separated feet. Friendly, curious and quietly capable; charming retro technology that belongs in an enchanted forest. No weapons, props, antennae, clothing or extra objects.
Style/medium: polished hand-authored low-resolution pixel art, native 64x64-game-sprite visual complexity, large crisp square pixel clusters on one consistent pixel grid; nearest-neighbor look. Strong readable outline in deep charcoal green, restrained 12-16 flat opaque color palette, at most three discrete tones per material. NO gradients, blur, antialiasing, soft light, painterly texture, fine noisy details, glossy 3D shading, perspective floor or cast shadow.
Composition: square canvas, whole robot centered, feet level, facing the viewer, fully visible and isolated with equal generous empty padding, approximately 68 percent of canvas height. One robot only. Make the silhouette clearly readable when displayed at 50-100 pixels tall.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, completely empty everywhere outside the sprite, including between limbs and in corner cutouts. No white backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no labels, UI, text, logos, watermark, dividers or ground.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production transparent 2x2 directional sprite sheet for a 2D pixel-art game.
Input image 1 is the canonical Atlas identity reference. Preserve this exact robot design: large CRT head, chamfered cream bezel, dark teal display with warm yellow square eyes and small U-shaped smile, olive-brass housing and side ports, deep charcoal green outline, cream square torso panel with teal diamond rune, articulated short arms with block hands, tiny separated legs and sturdy cream/olive feet. Keep the same proportions and palette in every cell.
Primary request: draw a model turnaround sheet of exactly FOUR full-body sprites of this SAME character on a square transparent canvas divided conceptually into exactly 2 columns and 2 rows of EQUAL SQUARE CELLS. Do not draw the grid.
The direction order is mandatory:
TOP LEFT: SOUTH, front view, looking directly toward viewer, both eyes and chest rune visible.
TOP RIGHT: NORTH, true back view, facing completely away, olive CRT rear casing with a simple small rear vent panel, back torso plate; NO face or chest rune visible.
BOTTOM LEFT: EAST, exact RIGHT-facing side profile, looking horizontally to the RIGHT of the canvas.
BOTTOM RIGHT: WEST, exact LEFT-facing side profile, looking horizontally to the LEFT of the canvas.
Each cell contains precisely one robot and all four have exactly the same character height, head size, limb proportions and feet baseline relative to their own cell. Full figures must fit comfortably within their own cell with equal generous transparent padding. Robot height is 70 percent of each square cell, horizontally centered. Feet baseline at 85 percent of each cell height, head top at 15 percent. No overlap, cropped parts or duplicated extra sprites.
Style/medium: polished flat 2D pixel art, crisp stepped square pixels and consistent grid, simple 12-16-color flat palette, only discrete block highlights. Simplify the slight surface texture of the reference into clean flat colors. Keep iconic features readable at 50-100 pixels tall. This is a game sprite atlas, not a 3D illustration: NO glossy render, gradient, blur, antialiasing, textured noise, floor, cast shadows or scenery.
Background: genuine transparent alpha in all blank space including between limbs. No checkerboard painting. No text, labels, arrows, numbers, frames, dividers, logos or watermarks. Exactly one front, one back, one right-facing profile and one left-facing profile, in the required order.
